# golang — 2017 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 5 golang CVEs of 2017 are in `data/cve/vendors/golang/2017.jsonl`.

### CVE-2017-20146 — Improper access control in github.com/gorilla/handlers
- Assigner: Go | Published: 2022-12-27 | Updated: 2025-04-11 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE 284: Improper Access Control
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

Usage of the CORS handler may apply improper CORS headers, allowing the requester to explicitly control the value of the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header, which bypasses the expected behavior of the Same Origin Policy.

Affected:
- github.com/gorilla/handlers / github.com/gorilla/handlers: affected 0 <1.3.0 (semver)

Credits: Evan J Johnson
